changeLogMessages: Fixed login credentials refreshing in the profile or default region instead of the region the login was performed in. Refresh is now sent to the `signInRegion` recorded in the cached login token, and tokens without it keep using the existing region resolution.

Fixed the cached login token not recording the region the login was performed in. It is now saved as `signInRegion`, except when the Sign-In endpoint is overridden, and kept when the token is refreshed.
